projects.title: Explainable AI for Open-Source GitHub Repository Classification
projects.summary: Develop an explainable machine learning model to classify GitHub repositories into categories like web development, machine learning, or data science, and provide insights into the decision-making process.

projects.title: Automated GitHub Issue Labeling using Natural Language Processing
projects.summary: Develop a machine learning model to automatically label GitHub issues based on their descriptions, reducing manual effort and improving issue tracking efficiency.
